header.title: Delete Account & Data Deletion Policy
header.subtitle: Information about deleting your account and personal data from applications developed by Vishal Sawant.

sections.title: Delete Account
sections.description:
You can permanently delete your account directly from within the app.

Navigation: Profile → Delete Account

Once deleted, your authentication account is permanently removed and cannot be recovered.

sections.title: Delete Data
sections.description:
You can delete individual pieces of app data without deleting your entire account, wherever the app supports it.

Example — Expense Tracker: swipe left on an expense to delete that record instantly.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.description: After account deletion, your data is permanently removed from our systems, unless a longer retention period is required by law.
